lines.en: Seawater polished this copper ingot.

lines.zh: 这条沙脊，我淹死前走过。
lines.en: This sand ridge — I walked it before I drowned.
Beach sand. Almost like home.

lines.zh: 膝弯卡着沙，弯一次响一次。
lines.en: Sand in my knees — click each time I bend.
Salt-soaked bones feel heavy.

lines.zh: 海草缠脚，走一步拖一步。
lines.en: Seagrass on my feet — each step drags.

lines.zh: 关节里塞满了沙，走一步响一声。
lines.en: Sand in every joint — one step, one click.

lines.zh: 脚踝的沙磨着骨，吱吱响。
lines.en: Sand grinds my ankle bone. Squeak, squeak.

lines.zh: 沙滩上，我的脚印一会儿就没了。
lines.en: My prints on the beach fade fast.
I know the seabed step for step.

lines.zh: 水下的骨头，还认得活人味。
lines.en: Bones underwater still know the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 一步一响，数到第七就乱。
lines.en: One step, one click. I lose count at seven.
Soaked too long, even anchors rot.

lines.zh: 潮水该来了，我却想不起等谁。
lines.en: The tide should come, but I forget who I wait for.
A little crab scuttles sideways in the sand.

lines.zh: 沙滩的水泡着我的脚骨。
lines.en: Beach water soaks my foot bones.
A severed finger in my hand. Whose?

lines.zh: 风一停，我连骨头都不响。
lines.en: When the wind stops, even my bones go quiet.

lines.zh: 晒了一整天，骨头还是潮。
lines.en: A whole day of sun, and my bones stay damp.
Seawater has softened my leg bones.
Soaked too long; even my bones went soft.

lines.zh: 只有浪拍礁石，没别的声音。
lines.en: Only waves on the rocks. Nothing else.
Keep the torch lit; in black water I'm blind.
Looking around — for me?

lines.zh: 隔着三步，就听见你心跳。
lines.en: Three paces off, I hear your heart.
The water behind you moved.
You carry the salt of the living.

lines.zh: 我身上还挂着海草和铜绿。
lines.en: Seaweed and verdigris still cling to me.

lines.zh: 你走路的样子，我像见过。
lines.en: The way you walk — I've seen it before.
Closer. Seawater clouded one eye.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，还是暖的。
lines.en: Your breath still fogs warm.

lines.zh: 别退，让我数数你的骨头。
lines.en: Don't back away. Let me count your bones.
The bones loosened, still attached.
One arm gone, I still chase.

lines.zh: 贝壳还嵌在我的肋骨间。
lines.en: Shells are still wedged between my ribs.
A nautilus shell is stuck on my shoulder.
Seawater got into the bone. It stings.
Hit me again and I'll scatter on the sand.

lines.zh: 沙滩的潮水，来回推着我。
lines.en: The tide pushes me back and forth.

lines.zh: 这一下，敲掉我半块锁骨。
lines.en: That knocked half my collarbone loose.

lines.zh: 你打在我第三根肋骨上。
lines.en: You hit my third rib. I'll remember.
Don't touch — there's still a shell in it.
Two hundred years hungry, and still.
Dead this long, and still I crave.
Don't take it away. Leave it on the sand.
Don't reach out. I bite.
Copper won't buy me a breath.

lines.zh: 海水泡过的骨头，还挂着铜绿。
lines.en: Sea-soaked bones still show copper green.
Hungry — I've held that word a long time.

lines.zh: 这腐肉味，跟我胃里一样。
lines.en: This rot smells like my own gut.
That rot smells like a wreck's hold.
Put it down. Three steps back.
You knocked my shoulder blade loose.

lines.zh: 肋骨被你撞得贴到心口。
lines.en: You knocked my ribs against where my heart was.
Off to drown yourself? Such a rush.

lines.zh: 我肩上的铜锭，比海水凉。
lines.en: The copper on my shoulder is colder than the sea.
Bumping wet bones — slippery, no?

lines.zh: 肩胛掉泥里了，帮我踢回来。
lines.en: My shoulder blade fell. Kick it back?

lines.zh: 沙滩的水冲过来，还是会疼。
lines.en: The beach water washes over, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 铜锈和鹦鹉螺，都在我兜里。
lines.en: Copper rust and a nautilus in my pocket.
I shift half a step. The sand is heavy.

lines.zh: 撞在我肋骨上，你倒不疼。
lines.en: You hit my ribs and didn't even flinch.

lines.zh: 沙滩的沙子，比我骨头还凉。
lines.en: The beach sand is colder than my bones.

lines.zh: 沙滩底下，我给你留了半个坟。
lines.en: Under the sand, I saved you half a grave.

lines.zh: 沙滩的骨头，还挂着海藻。
lines.en: Beach bones with seaweed still on them.

lines.zh: 你走了，我还站在这片沙上。
lines.en: You'll leave. I'll still stand on this sand.

lines.zh: 胸腔里只剩浪声，没有心跳。
lines.en: Only surf in my chest now. No heartbeat.

lines.zh: 溺死的人，骨头还在海边。
lines.en: The drowned man's bones stay by the shore.
The seaweed on me has not dried.

lines.zh: 我缺了几根骨，站不太正。
lines.en: I'm missing a few bones; I stand crooked.

lines.zh: 你要是也死了，就能一起。
lines.en: If you died too, we could be together.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺壳当婚戒，我戴不住。
lines.en: A nautilus shell ring will not stay on my bones.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺壳从肋骨缝里掉。
lines.en: A nautilus shell slips through my ribs.
My fingers are stiff, they won't grip.
Leave it on the sand. I'll get it.
What washes up on the sand is mine.

lines.zh: 我捡的鹦鹉螺壳，还没人要。
lines.en: My nautilus shell has no buyer yet.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺壳，从沙里翻出来。
lines.en: A nautilus shell, dug from the sand.
Picking this up is pointless.
A copper scrap from the sand. Keep it.

lines.zh: 这铜片上，有活人的手汗。
lines.en: Living sweat on this copper scrap.

lines.zh: 我的骨头里，还嵌着海沙。
lines.en: Sea sand is still packed in my bones.
The sand is soft. Move and you sink.

lines.zh: 海沙里泡久了，我认得活人。
lines.en: Long soaked in sea sand, I know the living.
You lifted a foot. So did I.
Turning won't help. The sand grabs.
Past the tide line — you.

lines.zh: 你回头那一下，我就锁定了。
lines.en: You glanced back. Locked.
Soaked pale, I come for you first.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的我，骨头被海水泡白。
lines.en: On the beach, seawater bleached my bones.

lines.zh: 沙滩下面，我泡得只剩骨头。
lines.en: Under the sand I soaked down to bone.

lines.zh: 沙滩就这么长，你能跑哪。
lines.en: This beach is only so long. Where will you go?
I searched the whole shore. Here you are.
The wave pulled back and I saw you.
The water will close your eyes.

lines.zh: 这片滩不埋活人，只埋我。
lines.en: This shore buries the dead, not the living.

lines.zh: 隔着水，我都听见你心跳。
lines.en: Through the water I hear your heart.
Rocks ahead. No way past.
Brace your knees and pant. I'm in no rush.
You run, and my bones itch.

lines.zh: 从潮涨追到潮落，还在追。
lines.en: From high tide to low, still chasing.
You can't run fast on sand. Save your strength.
Trip on the sand, and I'm there.
Slower. There's sand in my knees.

lines.zh: 我骨头缝里，还挂着海藻。
lines.en: Seaweed still hangs in my ribs.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的木腿，一步步跟着。
lines.en: These beach-worn wooden legs keep pace.
Ten more steps and you're in the water.

lines.zh: 光底下藏不住骨架的影子。
lines.en: A skeleton casts a long shadow in the light.
I don't need air. You can't keep up.
These prints in the sand are still warm.
Don't look back. Hear my steps in the sand.
My shadow stretches long in the water.
Seaweed drapes over my bones.

lines.zh: 海水都替我数着了，你输。
lines.en: Even the sea is counting. You've lost.
Stand still. Let the tide hear us.
Back away. The sea's behind you.
Why dodge? You can't run in sand.
Sunk this long, and still I swing.
Wet hands have you; you won't slip free.

lines.zh: 泡了这么久，就等这一下。
lines.en: Soaked this long for this one hit.
Knees buckle — lie down in the sand.
My shoulder popped out. Hear the click?
Light bones, but the blow lands heavy.
This arm is stiff. My swing is slow.
My nail grazed you. Half an inch off.
The copper ingot on my belt has rusted.
I've picked up half a dozen nautilus shells.
Not yet — I've one more swing.
Barnacles on my bones — go down.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺壳挂在我肋骨上。
lines.en: A nautilus shell hangs on my ribs.
Seaweed still on my hand. Sorry.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，滴着水。
lines.en: I rise from the sand, dripping.
The shoreline shifted.
The tide washed me up again.

lines.zh: 我身上滴着海水，离远点。
lines.en: I'm dripping seawater. Keep your distance.
Where the tide pulls out, I go.
The tide went out and left me on the sand.

lines.zh: 海水泡过的骨头，又醒了。
lines.en: Sea-soaked bones are awake again.
Knuckles first. Inch by inch.
The tide pushed me back onto the shore.
The tide went out; I'm still standing.

lines.zh: 这片灰天，我淹死那天也是。
lines.en: This grey sky — same as the day I drowned.
Eyes open, and my gut is full of seawater.
The sand is cold. So are the bones.
I only come ashore when the tide drops.
Fire cracks bone!
Fell on the rocks. My bones buzz.
Seawater fills my chest. Quiet, at least.
The surf flipped me head over heels.

lines.zh: 箭卡在肋骨缝里，拔不动。
lines.en: The arrow's wedged between my ribs.

lines.zh: 紫光烧得骨头里的盐发响。
lines.en: Violet light hisses in the salt of my bones.
Hungry enough that my bones loosen.
Lightning ran through my bones, glowing.
Bones too light to sink to the seabed.
